decisions.name: @parcel/watcher
decisions.rationale: The install script builds native code only when npm_config_build_from_source is true. The lockfile supplies platform prebuilds, and the Windows prebuild loads after a clean strict-policy npm ci with this script denied. Fixed non-watch qualification needs no source build; Linux and macOS prebuild qualification remains a CI obligation.

decisions.name: fsevents
decisions.rationale: This Darwin-only optional Jest/Vite dependency accelerates watch mode, which is outside the fixed non-watch lint, test, build, and release commands. Denial avoids unnecessary install-time native compilation; the required macOS qualification must continue to pass with this policy.

decisions.name: libxmljs2
decisions.rationale: The release emits and validates CycloneDX 1.6 JSON with Ajv; libxmljs2 is an optional XML-validation dependency and is not required by that governed path. The exact generator successfully produced and validated the required JSON library SBOM while this script remained blocked.
evidence: Phase 19B validated CycloneDX 1.6 JSON library SBOM smoke test on 2026-08-26

decisions.name: unrs-resolver
decisions.rationale: The lockfile installs the supported platform bindings directly; the postinstall is a fallback binding check/retrieval rather than required package construction. Denial prevents ambient install-time retrieval, and the complete blocking Jest suite passed through the installed resolver graph with the script blocked.
evidence: Phase 19B strict-policy full Jest suite: 103 suites, 2645 passed, 1 skipped

upgradeGate: Java structural differential tests and separately owned WebVOWL consumer differentials where applicable

Development-only Python tools use pyproject.toml and uv.lock with native locked validation; their selected distributions, retained terms, and copied-tool source records are inventoried in docs/provenance/third-party-material.json. Requalify the Snapper workaround and the Windows/Linux quality gates on tool updates.

dependencies.name: @hyperjump/uri
dependencies.role: RFC 3987 full-IRI lexical validation without normalization for ontology storage
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Version 1.3.6 uses the native parseIri grammar at both Functional Syntax and RDF/XML storage boundaries. This preserves syntactically valid IPvFuture IRIs without asking the isIri convenience API to enforce supported IP versions. Invalid or ill-formed input fails before replacement; lexical values are never normalized and exception messages are not inspected.
dependencies.networkBehavior: Pure in-memory identifier operations; no ambient network access
